caveats: This row aggregates ~21 civil suits by women assaulted on duty (2015-2017) by ex-deputy Richard Fischer; claims/suits began in 2017. Settlement total is approximate: dlawgroup says 'over $9.5 million', Yahoo/Times of San Diego says 'nearly $10 million' — 9500000 is the conservative reported floor, not an exact figure. Two sources (KTLA 403, CBS8 timeouts) were inaccessible, including the one citing an earlier $4.6M running total. Criminal: Fischer pleaded guilty (Sept 2019) to 4 felony + 3 misdemeanor counts (assault under color of authority, false imprisonment; 16 victims), sentenced Dec 2019 to 44 months; no sex-offender registration.
